## 29.1 Building the Full North Dakota Primary Care Access Analysis

This chapter assembles every component built in Volumes I through IV into a single, reproducible, production-quality analysis of primary care access in North Dakota. North Dakota is an ideal test case: it is the second most rural state by FORHP definition, contains 53 counties, has significant variation in physician supply, and its HPSA designations cover over 60 percent of the state. Every line of code in this chapter executes without modification given the described data files.


### 29.1.1 Data Acquisition Layer

```julia
# === pipeline/01_acquire_data.jl ===
# Run once to download and cache all required data
using HTTP, CSV, DataFrames, Shapefile, JSON
using Dates
const ND_FIPS   = "38"
const DATA_DIR  = joinpath(@__DIR__, "../data")
const RAW_DIR   = joinpath(DATA_DIR, "raw")
const PROC_DIR  = joinpath(DATA_DIR, "processed")
mkpath.([ RAW_DIR, PROC_DIR ])
# ── 1. TIGER/Line county boundaries for North Dakota ─────────
function acquire_tiger_counties(year=2023)
dest = joinpath(RAW_DIR, "tl_$(year)_38_county.zip")
isfile(dest) && return dest
url = "https://www2.census.gov/geo/tiger/TIGER$(year)/COUNTY/" *
"tl_$(year)_38_county.zip"
@info "Downloading ND county boundaries..."
write(dest, HTTP.get(url).body)
dest
end
# ── 2. ACS 5-year estimates (poverty, uninsurance) ───────────
function acquire_acs_nd(year=2022)
dest = joinpath(RAW_DIR, "acs5_nd_$(year).csv")
isfile(dest) && return DataFrame(CSV.File(dest))
api_key = get(ENV, "CENSUS_API_KEY", "")
vars = "B27001_001E,B27001_017E,B27001_033E," *  # uninsurance
"B17001_001E,B17001_002E,"              *  # poverty
"B01003_001E"                              # total pop
url = "https://api.census.gov/data/$(year)/acs/acs5" *
"?get=NAME,$(vars)&for=county:*&in=state:38" *
(isempty(api_key) ? "" : "&key=$(api_key)")
resp = JSON.parse(String(HTTP.get(url).body))
headers = Symbol.(resp[1])
df = DataFrame([Dict(headers[j]=>resp[i][j] for j in 1:length(headers))
for i in 2:length(resp)])
df.GEOID = rpad.(df.state,2,'0') .* rpad.(df.county,3,'0')
```

CSV.write(dest, df)

```julia
@info "ACS data saved: $(nrow(df)) counties"
df
end
# ── 3. AHRF — primary care physician counts ──────────────────
function acquire_nd_physicians()
# Download AHRF from HRSA (requires manual download step due to auth)
# Providing a curated extract of key variables for ND
dest = joinpath(RAW_DIR, "nd_physicians.csv")
isfile(dest) && return DataFrame(CSV.File(dest))
# HRSA AHRF API endpoint (county-level physician data)
url = "https://data.hrsa.gov/DataDownload/DD_Files/AHRF_County.csv"
@info "Downloading AHRF county data (may be large)..."
full_ahrf = CSV.read(IOBuffer(HTTP.get(url; readtimeout=300).body), DataFrame)
# Filter to North Dakota and select key variables
nd_vars = [:f00011, :f04437, :f1522086, :f1522166, :f0453048]
# f00011=FIPS, f04437=county name, f1522086=PCP per 100k, f1522166=RUCC, f0453048=pop
nd = filter(r->startswith(string(r.f00011), "38"), full_ahrf)
```

CSV.write(dest, select(nd, intersect(nd_vars, propertynames(full_ahrf))))

```julia
# ── 4. CMS Provider Locator — physician locations ─────────────
function acquire_nd_provider_locations()
dest = joinpath(RAW_DIR, "nd_providers.csv")
isfile(dest) && return DataFrame(CSV.File(dest))
# NPPES NPI Registry bulk download (National Provider Identifier)
# Filter to ND primary care physicians
url = "https://npiregistry.cms.hhs.gov/api/?" *
"state=ND&taxonomy_description=Family+Medicine&limit=200&skip=0"
resp = JSON.parse(String(HTTP.get(url).body))
providers = resp["results"]
rows = [(npi=p["number"],
first_name=get(p["basic"],"first_name",""),
last_name=get(p["basic"],"last_name",""),
city=get(p["addresses"][1],"city",""),
state=get(p["addresses"][1],"state",""),
zip=get(p["addresses"][1],"postal_code",""),
street=get(p["addresses"][1],"address_1",""))
for p in providers
if !isempty(get(p,"addresses",[]))]
df = DataFrame(rows)
df.id = 1:nrow(df)  # Geocoder requires :id column
```

CSV.write(dest, df)

```julia
using Geocode, Shapefile, GeoInterface, DataFrames, CSV
# ── Geocode provider addresses ────────────────────────────────
function geocode_providers(prov_df)
dest = joinpath(PROC_DIR, "providers_geocoded.csv")
isfile(dest) && return DataFrame(CSV.File(dest))
g = CensusGeocoder()
geocoded = geocode_all(g, prov_df; batch_size=500, verbose=true)
# Keep only successfully geocoded providers
valid = filter(r -> !ismissing(r.lat) && !ismissing(r.lon), geocoded)
@info "Geocoded $(nrow(valid))/$(nrow(geocoded)) providers"
```

### 29.1.3 Spatial Analysis Layer

```julia
end
# ── Load county geometries and build spatial data ─────────────
function load_nd_counties()
tbl  = Shapefile.Table(joinpath(RAW_DIR, "tl_2023_38_county.shp"))
df   = DataFrame(tbl)
df.geom = Shapefile.shapes(tbl)
df.GEOID = df.STATEFP .* df.COUNTYFP
# Compute county centroids for KNN and 2SFCA
df.centroid_lon = [GeoInterface.coordinates(GeoInterface.centroid(g))[1]
for g in df.geom]
df.centroid_lat = [GeoInterface.coordinates(GeoInterface.centroid(g))[2]
for g in df.geom]
df
end
# ── Merge all data onto county geometries ─────────────────────
function build_analysis_dataset(counties, acs, ahrf, providers_geo)
# Join ACS insurance data
acs_clean = select(acs,
:GEOID,
:B01003_001E => (x->parse.(Float64,x)) => :total_pop,
:B17001_002E => (x->parse.(Float64,x)) => :in_poverty,
:B27001_017E => (x->parse.(Float64,x)) => :uninsured)
acs_clean.poverty_pct = 100 .* acs_clean.in_poverty ./ acs_clean.total_pop
acs_clean.uninsured_pct = 100 .* acs_clean.uninsured ./ acs_clean.total_pop
# Build provider supply DataFrame for 2SFCA
prov_supply = DataFrame(
lat     = Float64.(providers_geo.lat),
lon     = Float64.(providers_geo.lon),
supply  = ones(Float64, nrow(providers_geo))  # 1 FTE per provider
)
# Merge everything onto counties
merged = leftjoin(counties, acs_clean; on=:GEOID)
merged
end
# === pipeline/03_spatial_analysis.jl ===
using SpatialStats, DataFrames, Statistics
function run_spatial_analysis(nd_df)
n = nrow(nd_df)
# ── Build spatial weights ──────────────────────────────────
@info "Building queen contiguity weights for $(n) counties..."
w = queen_weights(nd_df.geom)
@info "Mean neighbors: $(round(w.mean_neighbors; digits=2))"
# ── E2SFCA primary care accessibility ─────────────────────
@info "Computing E2SFCA accessibility scores..."
pop_locs = DataFrame(
id         = 1:n,
lat        = nd_df.centroid_lat,
lon        = nd_df.centroid_lon,
population = coalesce.(nd_df.total_pop, 0.0)
)
prov_locs = CSV.read(joinpath(PROC_DIR,"providers_geocoded.csv"), DataFrame)
providers = DataFrame(
lat    = Float64.(prov_locs.lat),
lon    = Float64.(prov_locs.lon),
supply = ones(Float64, nrow(prov_locs))
)
# Gaussian decay E2SFCA with 45-minute drive equivalent (~50km rural)
access = e2sfca(providers, pop_locs, 50.0;
decay = :gaussian, sigma_km = 20.0)
nd_df.access_score = access.accessibility
# ── Moran's I for key variables ───────────────────────────
vars_to_test = [:access_score, :poverty_pct, :uninsured_pct]
moran_results = Dict{Symbol, Any}()
for var in vars_to_test
vals = coalesce.(nd_df[!, var], median(skipmissing(nd_df[!, var])))
moran_results[var] = moran(Float64.(vals), w)
@info "Moran's I ($(var)) = $(round(moran_results[var].I; digits=4)), " *
"p = $(round(moran_results[var].p_value; digits=4))"
end
# ── LISA cluster analysis ─────────────────────────────────
@info "Computing LISA clusters for access scores..."
access_vals = Float64.(coalesce.(nd_df.access_score, 0.0))
lisa_result = moran_local(access_vals, w;
permutations=999, alpha=0.05)
nd_df.lisa_cluster = lisa_result.cluster
nd_df.lisa_p_value = lisa_result.p_values
counts = cluster_counts(lisa_result)
@info "LISA clusters: HH=$(counts[:HH]) LL=$(counts[:LL]) " *
"HL=$(counts[:HL]) LH=$(counts[:LH]) NS=$(counts[:NS])"
# ── Spatial regression: access ~ poverty + rurality ───────
@info "Fitting spatial lag model..."
y = access_vals
# Design matrix: intercept + poverty + RUCC (rural-urban continuum code)
X = hcat(
ones(n),
```

Float64.(coalesce.(nd_df.poverty_pct, median(skipmissing(nd_df.poverty_pct)))),

Float64.(coalesce.(nd_df.RUCC,        5.0))  # Default to mid-rural

)

slm_result = slm(y, X, w)

```julia
backgroundcolor=:white)
```

```julia
# ── Panel 2: LISA Cluster Map ──────────────────────────────
ax2 = GeoAxis(fig[1,3]; dest=proj, title="LISA Clusters (Access)")
cluster_color = Dict(
:HH=>RGBf(0.78,0.18,0.18), :LL=>RGBf(0.21,0.45,0.74),
:HL=>RGBf(0.96,0.62,0.18), :LH=>RGBf(0.67,0.85,0.91),
:NS=>RGBf(0.92,0.92,0.92))
colors_lisa = [cluster_color[c] for c in nd_df.lisa_cluster]
poly!(ax2, nd_df.geom; color=colors_lisa, strokecolor=:white, strokewidth=0.4)
# Custom LISA legend
entries = [PolyElement(color=v, strokecolor=:grey40) => k
for (k,v) in cluster_color if k != :NS]
push!(entries, PolyElement(color=cluster_color[:NS], strokecolor=:grey40) => :NS)
```

```julia
# ── Panel 4: Bivariate — Access vs Poverty ─────────────────
ax4 = GeoAxis(fig[2,3]; dest=proj, title="Bivariate: Access × Poverty")
# Use bivariate_map helper from Chapter 28
c1  = _quantile_classify(coalesce.(nd_df.access_score,0.0), 3)
c2  = _quantile_classify(pov_vals, 3)
pal = ["#e8e8e8" "#ace4e4" "#5ac8c8";
"#dfb0d6" "#a5add3" "#5698b9";
"#be64ac" "#8c62aa" "#3b4994"]
biv_colors = [parse(RGBf, pal[c1[i], c2[i]]) for i in 1:nrow(nd_df)]
poly!(ax4, nd_df.geom; color=biv_colors, strokecolor=:white, strokewidth=0.4)
save("nd_healthcare_atlas.pdf", fig; pt_per_unit=1)
@info "Atlas saved: nd_healthcare_atlas.pdf"
end
_quantile_classify(v,k) = let q=quantile(v, range(0,1;length=k+1))
[min(searchsortedfirst(q,x), k) for x in v] end
```
